meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加新渠道,调整自动触发,接入更多服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 NanoClaw 并想扩展它的消息渠道或触发方式
copy.tagline_en: Add new messaging channels and adjust how your assistant responds
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to add channels or change triggers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先提问弄清你的定制需求,然后帮你给 NanoClaw 添加新渠道(如 Telegram、Slack、邮件)、接入外部服务或调整助手行为,做完会告诉你如何重建和验证。
howto.when: 当你说要添加新消息渠道(如 Telegram、Slack、邮件)、更改触发词、接入外部服务,或提出其他 NanoClaw 定制需求时触发。它会先向你提问以明确需求。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加为输入渠道。
say.note: 它会确认接到哪个群组及隔离级别。

say.text: 加上一个日历 MCP 集成。
say.note: 它会询问服务、读写权限等再接入。

say.text: 改一下助手的人设,让它更简洁。
say.note: 它会定位对应群组的说明文件来修改。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first ask questions to understand your customization needs, then help you add new channels (e.g., Telegram, Slack, email), connect integrations, or adjust assistant behavior, and finally tell you how to rebuild and verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a new channel (e.g., Telegram, Slack, email), change triggers, connect services, or make other NanoClaw customizations. It is interactive and asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: It will confirm the target group and isolation level.
It will ask about the service and permissions, then wire it.

say_en.text: Change the assistant persona to be more concise.
say_en.note: It will edit the group's memory file.
